Alex Johnson: Quick sync — proposing a 2-week compatibility sprint to get our marketplace stacks "marketplace-ready" across AWS/GCP/Azure. Focus areas: Terraform modules, CI smoke harness, basic ARM (Graviton/Ampere) test matrix, and packaging notes for partner listings.
Marie Chen: +1. Do we have an owner for the Terraform module convergence? Last time we had drift between aws/ and gcp/ modules.
Devin Patel: I can take primary on modules. Plan: unify root variables, add provider blocks toggles, and add a compat test that runs `terraform plan` against sample envs.
Sophie Ramirez: For packaging we need the marketplace-specific metadata files (listing.json, icons, license). I can draft templates. Any legal flags for open-source vs bundled images? @Rita Kapoor do we need a review?
Rita Kapoor: We'll need license check and a brief security checklist for the partner listing. I can review the templates once Sophie has a prototype. ETA 2 business days.
Andrew Liu: infra-bot: run module-smoke on branch `marketplace-compat` please.
infra-bot: Started CI workflow: `module-smoke` (2145678927). Running on aws-us-east-1 (graviton), gcp-europe-west1 (n1), azure-westus2 (ampere preview).
Devin Patel: Putting a small smoke harness in repo under `ci/smoke/marketplace.sh` — it will: init, validate, plan -out and check plan for provider mismatches. Snippet: ```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
terraform init -backend=false
terraform validate
terraform plan -var-file=ci/test.tfvars -out=ci/plan.out
terraform show -json ci/plan.out > ci/plan.json
jq '.resource_changes | length' ci/plan.json
```
Sophie Ramirez: Nice. Also adding a short doc: `MARKETPLACE_README.md` with steps for creating listing bundle and upload checklist (size limits, icon sizes, accepted licenses).
Alex Johnson: Let's also record the hardware compat matrix. Short table in the repo: supported_cpu: [x86_64, arm64], recommended_ami/images per cloud, and a note on quantization/backcompat for our runtime.
Marie Chen: FYI — partner requires that modules include an examples/ folder for quick deploy. Add a `examples/basic` that deploys one small instance and a healthcheck.
Devin Patel: Will add examples and a tiny smoke that waits on a health endpoint. For cost reasons the smoke will destroy after pass.
Rita Kapoor: Add a security note: default secrets must not be in examples. Use placeholders and a script to generate ephemeral secrets.
Andrew Liu: infra-bot: report when `module-smoke` finishes. Tagging infra team for capacity on test accounts.
infra-bot: `module-smoke` completed: 3/3 environments passed, 0 failures. Artifacts: ci/plan.json (links in pipeline).
Alex Johnson: Great. Proposed milestones: day 2 — initial module refactor + examples; day 5 — smoke CI + marketplace README; day 10 — partner review & packaging; day 14 — submit to marketplace QA. Thoughts?
Marie Chen: Sounds reasonable. I'll coordinate partner tickes and set up a review on day 11.
Sophie Ramirez: I'll post the README draft to the PR.
Devin Patel: I'll open the PR later today and assign reviewers: @Marie Chen, @Andrew Liu, @Rita Kapoor.
Alex Johnson: Awesome. If infra capacity is needed ping me. We'll track in the sprint board under `marketplace/compat`. :rocket:
